text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This event is famed as an electrifying
sprint. A
1,200-meter G1 race, it's the
highlight of spring
at Chukyo
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And what's more...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The person I most admire is entering.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Dignified, elegant, noble, and
beautiful—she's
the closest in the entire
world to being like
Princess Fighter.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: Wavering between all sorts of different 'ways to be'...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Right.
choice_data_list: But beyond that, the ideal you is definitely there.
But beyond that, the ideal you is definitely there.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay!
choice_data_list: Go learn as much as you can.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You know that you're not suited for
running in
sprints.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Answer this, Kawakami. Did you enter
this race
just to emulate me?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: King... I...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll take that silence as your answer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If running in this race is not something
you can do
proudly, then withdraw at
once.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The G1 races are fit only for
Umamusume who
have pride in
themselves.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Can you say you feel proud in this very
moment?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A princess doesn't back down...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There are still... There are still things I
can learn
from you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Fear not, for I am here—the
first-rate
Umamusume, King Halo!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's King! Has she come to claim
the king's
throne again this year?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't she past her time already? How
long is she
gonna keep trying to stay
relevant?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Those who face challenges and those
who walk
their own path will not always
be met with praise
and admiration. To
grasp victory is to shatter
another's
dream.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My name is King Halo, and this is the
path I tread!
